122BOOL AcquireMonLock(Pokemon *mon) {
123 BOOL locked = FALSE;
124 if (!mon->box.partyDecrypted) {
125 locked = TRUE;
126 GF_ASSERT(!mon->box.boxDecrypted);
127 mon->box.partyDecrypted = TRUE;
128 mon->box.boxDecrypted = TRUE;
129 DECRYPT_PTY(mon);
130 DECRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
131 }
132 return locked;
133}

135BOOL ReleaseMonLock(Pokemon *mon, BOOL locked) {
136 BOOL prev = FALSE;
137 if (mon->box.partyDecrypted == TRUE && locked == TRUE) {
138 prev = TRUE;
139 mon->box.partyDecrypted = FALSE;
140 mon->box.boxDecrypted = FALSE;
141 ENCRYPT_PTY(mon);
142 mon->box.checksum = CHECKSUM(&mon->box);
143 ENCRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
144 }
145 return prev;
146}

188void CreateBoxMon(BoxPokemon *boxMon, int species, int level, int fixedIV, int hasFixedPersonality, int fixedPersonality, int otIdType, int fixedOtId) {
189 BOOL decry;
190 u32 exp;
191 u32 iv;
192 ZeroBoxMonData(boxMon);
193 decry = AcquireBoxMonLock(boxMon);
194 if (hasFixedPersonality == 0) {
195 fixedPersonality = (LCRandom() | (LCRandom() << 16));
196 }
197 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_PERSONALITY, &fixedPersonality);
198 if (otIdType == 2) {
199 do {
200 fixedOtId = (LCRandom() | (LCRandom() << 16));
201 } while (SHINY_CHECK(fixedOtId, fixedPersonality));
202 } else if (otIdType != 1) {
203 fixedOtId = 0;
204 }
205 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_OT_ID, &fixedOtId);
206 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_LANGUAGE, (void *)&gGameLanguage);
207 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, &species);
208 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPECIES_NAME, NULL);
209 exp = GetMonExpBySpeciesAndLevel(species, level);
210 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_EXPERIENCE, &exp);
211 exp = (u32)GetMonBaseStat(species, BASE_FRIENDSHIP);
212 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_FRIENDSHIP, &exp);
213 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_MET_LEVEL, &level);
214 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_MET_GAME, (void *)&gGameVersion);
215 exp = ITEM_POKE_BALL;
216 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_POKEBALL, &exp);
217 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_DP_POKEBALL, &exp);
218 if (fixedIV < 0x20) {
219 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_HP_IV, &fixedIV);
220 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_ATK_IV, &fixedIV);
221 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_DEF_IV, &fixedIV);
222 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPEED_IV, &fixedIV);
223 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPATK_IV, &fixedIV);
224 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPDEF_IV, &fixedIV);
225 } else {
226 exp = LCRandom();
227 iv = exp & 0x1F;
228 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_HP_IV, &iv);
229 iv = (exp & 0x3E0) >> 5;
230 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_ATK_IV, &iv);
231 iv = (exp & 0x7C00) >> 10;
232 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_DEF_IV, &iv);
233 exp = LCRandom();
234 iv = exp & 0x1F;
235 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPEED_IV, &iv);
236 iv = (exp & 0x3E0) >> 5;
237 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPATK_IV, &iv);
238 iv = (exp & 0x7C00) >> 10;
239 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPDEF_IV, &iv);
240 }
241 exp = (u32)GetMonBaseStat(species, BASE_ABILITY_1);
242 iv = (u32)GetMonBaseStat(species, BASE_ABILITY_2);
243 if (iv != 0) {
244 if (fixedPersonality & 1) {
245 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_ABILITY, &iv);
246 } else {
247 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_ABILITY, &exp);
248 }
249 } else {
250 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_ABILITY, &exp);
251 }
252 exp = GetBoxMonGender(boxMon);
253 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_GENDER, &exp);
254 InitBoxMonMoveset(boxMon);
255 ReleaseBoxMonLock(boxMon, decry);
256}

266void CreateMonWithGenderNatureLetter(Pokemon *mon, u16 species, u8 level, u8 fixedIv, u8 gender, u8 nature, u8 letter) {
267 u32 pid = 0;

269 if (letter != 0 && letter < 29) {

272 test = (u16)CALC_UNOWN_LETTER(pid);
273 } while (nature != GetNatureFromPersonality(pid) || gender != GetGenderBySpeciesAndPersonality(species, pid) || test != letter - 1);
274 } else {

280u32 GenPersonalityByGenderAndNature(u16 species, u8 gender, u8 nature) {
281 int pid = nature;
282 u8 ratio = (u8)GetMonBaseStat(species, BASE_GENDER_RATIO);
283 switch (ratio) {
284 case MON_RATIO_MALE:
285 case MON_RATIO_FEMALE:
286 case MON_RATIO_UNKNOWN:
287 break;
288 default:
289 if (gender == MON_MALE) {
290 // Smallest increment that forces the low byte to exceed the
291 // gender ratio, thus making the mon male
292 pid = 25 * ((ratio / 25) + 1);
293 pid += nature;
294 }
295 break;
296 }
297 return (u32)pid;
298}

314void CalcMonStats(Pokemon *mon) {
315 BASE_STATS *baseStats;
316 int level;
317 int maxHp;
318 int hpIv;
319 int hpEv;
320 int atkIv;
321 int defIv;
322 int speedIv;
323 int spatkIv;
324 int spdefIv;
325 int atkEv;
326 int defEv;
327 int speedEv;
328 int spatkEv;
329 int spdefEv;
330 int form;
331 int hp;
332 int species;
333 int newMaxHp;
334 int newAtk;
335 int newDef;
336 int newSpeed;
337 int newSpatk;
338 int newSpdef;
339
340 BOOL decry = AcquireMonLock(mon);
341 level = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_LEVEL, NULL);
342 maxHp = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_MAX_HP, NULL);
343 hp = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_HP, NULL);
344 hpIv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_HP_IV, NULL);
345 hpEv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_HP_EV, NULL);
346 atkIv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_ATK_IV, NULL);
347 atkEv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_ATK_EV, NULL);
348 defIv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_DEF_IV, NULL);
349 defEv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_DEF_EV, NULL);
350 speedIv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPEED_IV, NULL);
351 speedEv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPEED_EV, NULL);
352 spatkIv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPATK_IV, NULL);
353 spatkEv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPATK_EV, NULL);
354 spdefIv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPDEF_IV, NULL);
355 spdefEv = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPDEF_EV, NULL);
356 form = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_FORM, NULL);
357 species = (int)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL);
358
359 baseStats = (BASE_STATS *)Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_DEFAULT, sizeof(BASE_STATS));
360 LoadMonBaseStats_HandleAlternateForm(species, form, baseStats);
361
362 if (species == SPECIES_SHEDINJA) {
363 newMaxHp = 1;
364 } else {
365 newMaxHp = (baseStats->hp * 2 + hpIv + hpEv / 4) * level / 100 + level + 10;
366 }
367 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_MAX_HP, &newMaxHp);
368
369 newAtk = (baseStats->atk * 2 + atkIv + atkEv / 4) * level / 100 + 5;
370 newAtk = ModifyStatByNature(GetMonNature(mon), (u16)newAtk, STAT_ATK);
371 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_ATK, &newAtk);
372
373 newDef = (baseStats->def * 2 + defIv + defEv / 4) * level / 100 + 5;
374 newDef = ModifyStatByNature(GetMonNature(mon), (u16)newDef, STAT_DEF);
375 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_DEF, &newDef);
376
377 newSpeed = (baseStats->speed * 2 + speedIv + speedEv / 4) * level / 100 + 5;
378 newSpeed = ModifyStatByNature(GetMonNature(mon), (u16)newSpeed, STAT_SPEED);
379 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPEED, &newSpeed);
380
381 newSpatk = (baseStats->spatk * 2 + spatkIv + spatkEv / 4) * level / 100 + 5;
382 newSpatk = ModifyStatByNature(GetMonNature(mon), (u16)newSpatk, STAT_SPATK);
383 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SP_ATK, &newSpatk);
384
385 newSpdef = (baseStats->spdef * 2 + spdefIv + spdefEv / 4) * level / 100 + 5;
386 newSpdef = ModifyStatByNature(GetMonNature(mon), (u16)newSpdef, STAT_SPDEF);
387 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SP_DEF, &newSpdef);
388
389 Heap_Free(baseStats);
390
391 if (hp != 0 || maxHp == 0) {
392 if (species == SPECIES_SHEDINJA) {
393 hp = 1;
394 } else if (hp == 0) {
395 hp = newMaxHp;
396 } else if (newMaxHp - maxHp < 0) {
397 if (hp > newMaxHp) {
398 hp = newMaxHp;
399 }
400 } else {
401 hp += newMaxHp - maxHp;
402 }
403 }
404 if (hp != 0) {
405 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_HP, &hp);
406 }
407 ReleaseMonLock(mon, decry);
408}

481static u32 GetBoxMonDataInternal(BoxPokemon *boxMon, int attr, void *dest) {
482 u32 ret = 0;
483 PokemonDataBlockA *blockA = &GetSubstruct(boxMon, boxMon->personality, 0)->blockA;
484 PokemonDataBlockB *blockB = &GetSubstruct(boxMon, boxMon->personality, 1)->blockB;
485 PokemonDataBlockC *blockC = &GetSubstruct(boxMon, boxMon->personality, 2)->blockC;
486 PokemonDataBlockD *blockD = &GetSubstruct(boxMon, boxMon->personality, 3)->blockD;
487
488 switch (attr) {
489 default:
490 ret = 0;
491 break;
492 case MON_DATA_PERSONALITY:
493 ret = boxMon->personality;
494 break;
495 case MON_DATA_IS_PARTY_DECRYPTED:
496 ret = boxMon->partyDecrypted;
497 break;
498 case MON_DATA_IS_BOX_DECRYPTED:
499 ret = boxMon->boxDecrypted;
500 break;
501 case MON_DATA_CHECKSUM_FAILED:
502 ret = boxMon->checksumFailed;
503 break;
504 case MON_DATA_CHECKSUM:
505 ret = boxMon->checksum;
506 break;
507 case MON_DATA_SPECIES_EXISTS:
508 if (blockA->species != SPECIES_NONE) {
509 ret = TRUE;
510 } else {
511 ret = FALSE;
512 }
513 break;
514 case MON_DATA_SANITY_IS_EGG:
515 ret = boxMon->checksumFailed;
516 if (!ret) {
517 ret = blockB->isEgg;
518 }
519 break;
520 case MON_DATA_SPECIES_OR_EGG:
521 ret = blockA->species;
522 if (ret != SPECIES_NONE && (blockB->isEgg || boxMon->checksumFailed)) {
523 ret = SPECIES_EGG;
524 }
525 break;
526 case MON_DATA_LEVEL:
527 ret = (u32)CalcLevelBySpeciesAndExp(blockA->species, blockA->exp);
528 break;
529 case MON_DATA_SPECIES:
530 if (boxMon->checksumFailed) {
531 ret = SPECIES_EGG;
532 } else {
533 ret = blockA->species;
534 }
535 break;
536 case MON_DATA_HELD_ITEM:
537 ret = blockA->heldItem;
538 break;
539 case MON_DATA_OT_ID:
540 ret = blockA->otID;
541 break;
542 case MON_DATA_EXPERIENCE:
543 ret = blockA->exp;
544 break;
545 case MON_DATA_FRIENDSHIP:
546 ret = blockA->friendship;
547 break;
548 case MON_DATA_ABILITY:
549 ret = blockA->ability;
550 break;
551 case MON_DATA_MARKINGS:
552 ret = blockA->markings;
553 break;
554 case MON_DATA_LANGUAGE:
555 ret = blockA->originLanguage;
556 break;
557 case MON_DATA_HP_EV:
558 ret = blockA->hpEV;
559 break;
560 case MON_DATA_ATK_EV:
561 ret = blockA->atkEV;
562 break;
563 case MON_DATA_DEF_EV:
564 ret = blockA->defEV;
565 break;

886void SetMonData(Pokemon *mon, int attr, const void *value) {
887 u32 checksum;
888 if (!mon->box.partyDecrypted) {
889 DECRYPT_PTY(mon);
890 DECRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
891 checksum = CHECKSUM(&mon->box);
892 if (checksum != mon->box.checksum) {
893 GF_ASSERT(checksum == mon->box.checksum);
894 mon->box.checksumFailed = TRUE;
895 ENCRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
896 return;
897 }
898 }
899 SetMonDataInternal(mon, attr, value);
900 if (!mon->box.partyDecrypted) {
901 ENCRYPT_PTY(mon);
902 mon->box.checksum = CHECKSUM(&mon->box);
903 ENCRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
904 }
905}
906
907static void SetMonDataInternal(Pokemon *mon, int attr, const void *value) {
908#define VALUE(type) (*(const type *)value)
909 switch (attr) {
910 case MON_DATA_STATUS:
911 mon->party.status = VALUE(u32);
912 break;
913 case MON_DATA_LEVEL:
914 mon->party.level = VALUE(u8);
915 break;
916 case MON_DATA_BALL_CAPSULE_ID:
917 mon->party.ballCapsuleID = VALUE(u8);
918 break;
919 case MON_DATA_HP:
920 mon->party.hp = VALUE(u16);
921 break;
922 case MON_DATA_MAX_HP:
923 mon->party.maxHP = VALUE(u16);
924 break;
925 case MON_DATA_ATK:
926 mon->party.atk = VALUE(u16);
927 break;
928 case MON_DATA_DEF:
929 mon->party.def = VALUE(u16);
930 break;
931 case MON_DATA_SPEED:
932 mon->party.speed = VALUE(u16);
933 break;
934 case MON_DATA_SP_ATK:
935 mon->party.spatk = VALUE(u16);
936 break;
937 case MON_DATA_SP_DEF:
938 mon->party.spdef = VALUE(u16);
939 break;
940 case MON_DATA_MAIL:
941 Mail_Copy((const Mail *)value, &mon->party.mail);
942 break;
943 case MON_DATA_BALL_CAPSULE:
944 CopyCapsule((const CAPSULE *)value, &mon->party.sealCoords);
945 break;
946 default:
947 SetBoxMonDataInternal(&mon->box, attr, value);
948 break;
949 }
950#undef VALUE
951}

953void SetBoxMonData(BoxPokemon *boxMon, int attr, const void *value) {
954 u32 checksum;
955 if (!boxMon->boxDecrypted) {
956 DECRYPT_BOX(boxMon);
957 checksum = CHECKSUM(boxMon);
958 if (checksum != boxMon->checksum) {
959 GF_ASSERT(checksum == boxMon->checksum);
960 boxMon->checksumFailed = TRUE;
961 ENCRYPT_BOX(boxMon);
962 return;
963 }
964 }
965 SetBoxMonDataInternal(boxMon, attr, value);
966 if (!boxMon->boxDecrypted) {
967 boxMon->checksum = CHECKSUM(boxMon);
968 ENCRYPT_BOX(boxMon);
969 }
970}

1187 case MON_DATA_FORM:

1191 blockB->unused1 = VALUE(u8);
1192 break;
1193 case MON_DATA_UNUSED_114:
1194 blockB->unused2 = VALUE(u16);
1195 break;
1196 case MON_DATA_NICKNAME_FLAT_COMPARE:
1197 GetSpeciesNameIntoArray(blockA->species, HEAP_ID_DEFAULT, namebuf);
1198 blockB->hasNickname = StringNotEqual(namebuf, value);
1199 // fallthrough
1200 case MON_DATA_NICKNAME:
1201 for (i = 0; i < POKEMON_NAME_LENGTH + 1; i++) {
1202 blockC->nickname[i] = VALUE(u16);
1203 value = (void *const)((char *)value + 2);
1204 }
1205 break;
1206 case MON_DATA_NICKNAME_STRING_AND_FLAG:
1207 GetSpeciesNameIntoArray(blockA->species, HEAP_ID_DEFAULT, namebuf2);
1208 CopyStringToU16Array(value, namebuf3, POKEMON_NAME_LENGTH + 1);
1209 blockB->hasNickname = StringNotEqual(namebuf2, namebuf3);
1210 // fallthrough
1211 case MON_DATA_NICKNAME_STRING:
1212 CopyStringToU16Array(value, blockC->nickname, POKEMON_NAME_LENGTH + 1);
1213 break;
1214 case MON_DATA_UNUSED_121:
1215 blockC->unused = VALUE(u8);
1216 break;
1217 case MON_DATA_MET_GAME:
1218 blockC->originGame = VALUE(u8);
1219 break;
1220 case MON_DATA_SUPER_COOL_RIBBON:
1221 case MON_DATA_SUPER_COOL_RIBBON_GREAT:
1222 case MON_DATA_SUPER_COOL_RIBBON_ULTRA:
1223 case MON_DATA_SUPER_COOL_RIBBON_MASTER:
1224 case MON_DATA_SUPER_BEAUTY_RIBBON:
1225 case MON_DATA_SUPER_BEAUTY_RIBBON_GREAT:
1226 case MON_DATA_SUPER_BEAUTY_RIBBON_ULTRA:
1227 case MON_DATA_SUPER_BEAUTY_RIBBON_MASTER:
1228 case MON_DATA_SUPER_CUTE_RIBBON:
1229 case MON_DATA_SUPER_CUTE_RIBBON_GREAT:
1230 case MON_DATA_SUPER_CUTE_RIBBON_ULTRA:
1231 case MON_DATA_SUPER_CUTE_RIBBON_MASTER:
1232 case MON_DATA_SUPER_SMART_RIBBON:
1233 case MON_DATA_SUPER_SMART_RIBBON_GREAT:
1234 case MON_DATA_SUPER_SMART_RIBBON_ULTRA:
1235 case MON_DATA_SUPER_SMART_RIBBON_MASTER:
1236 case MON_DATA_SUPER_TOUGH_RIBBON:
1237 case MON_DATA_SUPER_TOUGH_RIBBON_GREAT:
1238 case MON_DATA_SUPER_TOUGH_RIBBON_ULTRA:
1239 case MON_DATA_SUPER_TOUGH_RIBBON_MASTER:
1240 case MON_DATA_UNUSED_RIBBON_143:
1241 mask = 1 << (attr - MON_DATA_SUPER_COOL_RIBBON);
1242 if (VALUE(u8)) {
1243 blockC->ribbonsDS2 |= mask;
1244 } else {
1245 blockC->ribbonsDS2 &= mask ^ 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;
1246 }

1248 case MON_DATA_OT_NAME:
1249 for (i = 0; i < PLAYER_NAME_LENGTH + 1; i++) {
1250 blockD->otName[i] = VALUE(u16);

1252 }

1254 case MON_DATA_OT_NAME_STRING:

1256 break;
1257 case MON_DATA_EGG_YEAR:

1260 case MON_DATA_EGG_MONTH:

1266 case MON_DATA_MET_YEAR:

1270 blockD->metMonth = VALUE(u8);
1271 break;
1272 case MON_DATA_MET_DAY:
1273 blockD->metDay = VALUE(u8);
1274 break;
1275 case MON_DATA_EGG_LOCATION:
1276 case MON_DATA_EGG_LOCATION_PTHGSS:
1277 if (VALUE(u16) == MAPSEC_MYSTERY_ZONE || LocationIsDiamondPearlCompatible(VALUE(u16)) == TRUE) {
1278 blockD->EggLocation_DP = VALUE(u16);
1279 blockB->EggLocation_PtHGSS = VALUE(u16);
1280 } else {
1281 blockD->EggLocation_DP = METLOC_FARAWAY_PLACE;
1282 blockB->EggLocation_PtHGSS = VALUE(u16);
1283 }
1284 break;
1285 case MON_DATA_MET_LOCATION:
1286 case MON_DATA_MET_LOCATION_PTHGSS:
1287 if (VALUE(u16) == MAPSEC_MYSTERY_ZONE || LocationIsDiamondPearlCompatible(VALUE(u16)) == TRUE) {
1288 blockD->MetLocation_DP = VALUE(u16);
1289 blockB->MetLocation_PtHGSS = VALUE(u16);
1290 } else {
1291 blockD->MetLocation_DP = METLOC_FARAWAY_PLACE;
1292 blockB->MetLocation_PtHGSS = VALUE(u16);
1293 }
1294 break;
1295 case MON_DATA_POKERUS:
1296 blockD->pokerus = VALUE(u8);
1297 break;
1298 case MON_DATA_POKEBALL:
1299 if (VALUE(u16) >= ITEM_MASTER_BALL && VALUE(u16) <= ITEM_CHERISH_BALL) {
1300 blockD->HGSS_Pokeball = VALUE(u16);
1301 blockD->pokeball = VALUE(u16);
1302 } else if (VALUE(u16) >= ITEM_FAST_BALL && VALUE(u16) <= ITEM_SPORT_BALL) {
1303 blockD->HGSS_Pokeball = VALUE(u16) - (ITEM_FAST_BALL - BALL_FAST);
1304 blockD->pokeball = BALL_POKE;

1307 }
1308 break;

1311 break;
1312 case MON_DATA_OT_GENDER:

1314 break;
1315 case MON_DATA_MET_TERRAIN:
1316 blockD->metTerrain = VALUE(u8);
1317 break;
1318 case MON_DATA_COMBINED_IVS:
1319 blockB->hpIV = (VALUE(u32) >> 0) & 0x1F;
1320 blockB->atkIV = (VALUE(u32) >> 5) & 0x1F;
1321 blockB->defIV = (VALUE(u32) >> 10) & 0x1F;
1322 blockB->speedIV = (VALUE(u32) >> 15) & 0x1F;
1323 blockB->spAtkIV = (VALUE(u32) >> 20) & 0x1F;
1324 blockB->spDefIV = (VALUE(u32) >> 25) & 0x1F;
1325 break;
1326 case MON_DATA_SPECIES_NAME:
1327 speciesName = GetSpeciesName(blockA->species, HEAP_ID_DEFAULT);
1328 CopyStringToU16Array(speciesName, blockC->nickname, POKEMON_NAME_LENGTH + 1);
1329 String_Delete(speciesName);
1330 break;
1331 case MON_DATA_SHINY_LEAF_A:
1332 case MON_DATA_SHINY_LEAF_B:
1333 case MON_DATA_SHINY_LEAF_C:
1334 case MON_DATA_SHINY_LEAF_D:
1335 case MON_DATA_SHINY_LEAF_E:
1336 case MON_DATA_SHINY_LEAF_CROWN:
1337 if (value == NULL) {

1339 } else if (VALUE(u8) != 0) {
1340 blockB->HGSS_shinyLeaves |= 1 << (attr - MON_DATA_SHINY_LEAF_A);
1341 } else {
1342 blockB->HGSS_shinyLeaves &= (1 << (attr - MON_DATA_SHINY_LEAF_A)) ^ 0x3F;
1343 }
1344 break;
1345 case MON_DATA_MOOD:
1346 blockD->mood = VALUE(u8);
1347 break;
1348 }
1349#undef VALUE
1350}

1352void AddMonData(Pokemon *mon, int attr, int value) {
1353 u32 checksum;
1354 if (!mon->box.partyDecrypted) {
1355 DECRYPT_PTY(mon);
1356 DECRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
1357 checksum = CHECKSUM(&mon->box);
1358 if (checksum != mon->box.checksum) {
1359 GF_ASSERT(checksum == mon->box.checksum);
1360 ENCRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
1361 return;
1362 }
1363 }
1364 AddMonDataInternal(mon, attr, value);
1365 if (!mon->box.partyDecrypted) {
1366 ENCRYPT_PTY(mon);
1367 mon->box.checksum = CHECKSUM(&mon->box);
1368 ENCRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
1369 }
1370}
1371
1372static void AddMonDataInternal(Pokemon *mon, int attr, int value) {
1373 s32 maxHP;
1374 switch (attr) {
1375 case MON_DATA_HP:
1376 maxHP = mon->party.maxHP;
1377 if ((s32)(mon->party.hp + value) > maxHP) {
1378 mon->party.hp = (u16)maxHP;
1379 } else {
1380 mon->party.hp += value;
1381 }
1382 break;
1383 case MON_DATA_STATUS:
1384 case MON_DATA_LEVEL:
1385 case MON_DATA_BALL_CAPSULE_ID:
1386 case MON_DATA_MAX_HP:
1387 case MON_DATA_ATK:
1388 case MON_DATA_DEF:
1389 case MON_DATA_SPEED:
1390 case MON_DATA_SP_ATK:
1391 case MON_DATA_SP_DEF:
1392 case MON_DATA_MAIL:
1393 // case MON_DATA_BALL_CAPSULE:
1394 GF_ASSERT(FALSE);
1395 break;
1396 default:
1397 AddBoxMonDataInternal(&mon->box, attr, value);
1398 break;
1399 }
1400}

1402static void AddBoxMonDataInternal(BoxPokemon *boxMon, int attr, int value) {
1403 PokemonDataBlockA *blockA = &GetSubstruct(boxMon, boxMon->personality, 0)->blockA;
1404 PokemonDataBlockB *blockB = &GetSubstruct(boxMon, boxMon->personality, 1)->blockB;
1405 PokemonDataBlockC *blockC = &GetSubstruct(boxMon, boxMon->personality, 2)->blockC;
1406 PokemonDataBlockD *blockD = &GetSubstruct(boxMon, boxMon->personality, 3)->blockD;
1407
1408 switch (attr) {
1409 case MON_DATA_EXPERIENCE:
1410 if (blockA->exp + value > GetMonExpBySpeciesAndLevel(blockA->species, 100)) {
1411 blockA->exp = GetMonExpBySpeciesAndLevel(blockA->species, 100);
1412 } else {
1413 blockA->exp += value;
1414 }
1415 break;
1416 case MON_DATA_FRIENDSHIP: {
1417 int friendship = blockA->friendship;
1418 if (friendship + value > FRIENDSHIP_MAX) {
1419 friendship = FRIENDSHIP_MAX;
1420 }
1421 friendship += value;
1422 if (friendship < 0) {
1423 friendship = 0;
1424 }
1425 blockA->friendship = friendship;
1426 } break;
1427 case MON_DATA_HP_EV:
1428 blockA->hpEV += value;
1429 break;
1430 case MON_DATA_ATK_EV:
1431 blockA->atkEV += value;
1432 break;
1433 case MON_DATA_DEF_EV:
1434 blockA->defEV += value;
1435 break;
1436 case MON_DATA_SPEED_EV:
1437 blockA->speedEV += value;
1438 break;
1439 case MON_DATA_SPATK_EV:
1440 blockA->spAtkEV += value;
1441 break;
1442 case MON_DATA_SPDEF_EV:
1443 blockA->spDefEV += value;
1444 break;
1445 case MON_DATA_COOL:
1446 if (blockA->cool + value > 255) {
1447 blockA->cool = 255;
1448 } else {
1449 blockA->cool += value;
1450 }
1451 break;
1452 case MON_DATA_BEAUTY:
1453 if (blockA->beauty + value > 255) {
1454 blockA->beauty = 255;

1456 blockA->beauty += value;

1458 break;

1865u8 GetPercentProgressTowardsNextLevel(Pokemon *mon) {
1866 BOOL decry = AcquireMonLock(mon);
1867 u16 species = (u16)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL);

1870 u32 hi = GetMonExpBySpeciesAndLevel(species, level + 1);

1873 return (u8)(100 * (cur - lo) / (hi - lo));

1935int CalcLevelBySpeciesAndExp_PreloadedPersonal(BASE_STATS *personal, u16 species, u32 exp) {
1936#pragma unused(species)
1937 static u32 table[101];
1938 int i;
1939 LoadGrowthTable(GetPersonalAttr(personal, BASE_GROWTH_RATE), table);
1940 for (i = 1; i < 101; i++) {
1941 if (table[i] > exp) {
1942 break;
1943 }
1944 }
1945 return i - 1;
1946}

1965 { 1, -1, 0, 0, 0 },
1966 { 1, 0, -1, 0, 0 },
1967 { 1, 0, 0, -1, 0 },
1968 { 1, 0, 0, 0, -1 },

1991u16 ModifyStatByNature(u8 nature, u16 n, u8 statIndex) {
1992 u16 retVal;
1993
1994 // Dont modify HP, Accuracy, or Evasion by nature
1995 if (statIndex < STAT_ATK || statIndex > STAT_SPDEF) {
1996 return n;
1997 }
1998
1999 switch (gNatureStatMods[nature][statIndex - 1]) {
2000 case 1:
2001 // NOTE: will overflow for n > 595 because the intermediate value is cast to u16 before the division.
2002 retVal = n * 110;
2003 retVal /= 100;
2004 break;
2005 case -1:
2006 // NOTE: will overflow for n > 728, see above
2007 retVal = n * 90;
2008 retVal /= 100;
2009 break;
2010 default:
2011 retVal = n;
2012 break;
2013 }
2014 return retVal;
2015}

2017static const s8 sFriendshipModTable[FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_NUM][FRIENDSHIP_TIER_NUM] = {
2018 { 5, 3, 2 }, // FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_GROW_LEVEL
2019 { 5, 3, 2 }, // FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_VITAMIN
2020 { 1, 1, 0 }, // FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_BATTLE_ITEM
2021 { 3, 2, 1 }, // FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_LEAGUE_BATTLE
2022 { 1, 1, 0 }, // FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_LEARN_TMHM
2023 { 1, 1, 1 }, // FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_WALKING
2024 { -1, -1, -1 }, // FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_FAINT_SMALL
2025 { -5, -5, -10 }, // FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_HEAL_FIELD_PSN

2027 { 3, 2, 1 }, // FRIENDHSIP_EVENT_CONTEST_WIN
2028};

2030void MonApplyFriendshipMod(Pokemon *mon, u8 kind, u16 location) {
2031 u16 species;
2032 u8 effect;
2033 u8 tier;
2034 s16 friendship;
2035 s8 mod;
2036
2037 if (kind == FRIENDSHIP_EVENT_WALKING && (LCRandom() & 1)) {
2038 return;
2039 }
2040
2041 species = (u16)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES_OR_EGG, NULL);
2042 if (species == SPECIES_NONE || species == SPECIES_EGG) {
2043 return;
2044 }
2045
2046 effect = (u8)GetItemAttr((u16)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_HELD_ITEM, NULL), ITEMATTR_HOLD_EFFECT, HEAP_ID_DEFAULT);
2047 tier = FRIENDSHIP_TIER_LOW;
2048 friendship = (s16)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_FRIENDSHIP, NULL);
2049 if (friendship >= FRIENDSHIP_TIER_MID_MIN) {
2050 tier++;
2051 }
2052 if (friendship >= FRIENDSHIP_TIER_HI_MIN) {
2053 tier++;
2054 }
2055 mod = sFriendshipModTable[kind][tier];
2056 if (mod > 0 && GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_DP_POKEBALL, NULL) == BALL_LUXURY) {
2057 mod++;
2058 }
2059 if (mod > 0 && GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_EGG_LOCATION, NULL) == location) {
2060 mod++;
2061 }
2062 if (mod > 0 && effect == HOLD_EFFECT_FRIENDSHIP_UP) {
2063 mod = (s8)(mod * 150 / 100);
2064 }
2065 friendship += mod;
2066 if (friendship < 0) {
2067 friendship = 0;
2068 }
2069 if (friendship > FRIENDSHIP_MAX) {
2070 friendship = FRIENDSHIP_MAX;
2071 }
2072 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_FRIENDSHIP, &friendship);
2073}

2131
2132u32 GenerateShinyPersonality(u32 otid) {
2133 int r4;
2134 u16 r6;
2135 u16 r5;
2136 otid = (u32)((((otid & 0xFFFF0000) >> 16) ^ (otid & 0xFFFF)) >> 3u);
2137 r6 = (u16)(LCRandom() & 7);
2138 r5 = (u16)(LCRandom() & 7);
2139 for (r4 = 0; r4 < 13; r4++) {
2140 if (MaskOfFlagNo(r4) & otid) {
2141 if (LCRandom() & 1) {
2142 r6 |= MaskOfFlagNo(r4 + 3);
2143 } else {
2144 r5 |= MaskOfFlagNo(r4 + 3);
2145 }
2146 } else if (LCRandom() & 1) {
2147 r6 |= MaskOfFlagNo(r4 + 3);
2148 r5 |= MaskOfFlagNo(r4 + 3);
2149 }
2150 }
2151 return (u32)((r5 << 16) | r6);
2152}

2185
2186void GetMonSpriteCharAndPlttNarcIdsEx(PokepicTemplate *pokepicTemplate, u16 species, u8 gender, u8 whichFacing, u8 shiny, u8 form, u32 personality) {
2187 pokepicTemplate->species = SPECIES_NONE;
2188 pokepicTemplate->isAnimated = FALSE;
2189 pokepicTemplate->personality = 0;
2190 form = sub_02070438(species, form);
2191 switch (species) {
2192 case SPECIES_BURMY:
2193 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2194 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing / 2 + 0x48 + form * 2);
2195 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xAA + form * 2);
2196 break;
2197 case SPECIES_WORMADAM:
2198 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2199 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing / 2 + 0x4E + form * 2);
2200 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xB0 + form * 2);
2201 break;
2202 case SPECIES_SHELLOS:
2203 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2204 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing + 0x54 + form);
2205 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xB6 + form * 2);
2206 break;
2207 case SPECIES_GASTRODON:
2208 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2209 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing + 0x58 + form);
2210 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xBA + form * 2);
2211 break;
2212 case SPECIES_CHERRIM:
2213 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2214 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing + 0x5C + form);
2215 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny * 2 + 0xBE + form);
2216 break;
2217 case SPECIES_ARCEUS:
2218 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2219 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing / 2 + 0x60 + form * 2);
2220 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xC2 + form * 2);
2221 break;
2222 case SPECIES_CASTFORM:
2223 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2224 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing * 2 + 0x40 + form);
2225 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny * 4 + 0xA2 + form);
2226 break;
2227 case SPECIES_DEOXYS:
2228 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2229 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing / 2 + form * 2);
2230 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0x9E);
2231 break;
2232 case SPECIES_UNOWN:
2233 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2234 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing / 2 + 0x8 + form * 2);
2235 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xA0);
2236 break;
2237 case SPECIES_EGG: // egg, manaphy egg
2238 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2239 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(0x84 + form);
2240 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(0xE6 + form);
2241 break;
2242 case SPECIES_MANAPHY_EGG: // bad egg
2243 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2244 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = 0x84;
2245 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = 0xE6;
2246 break;
2247 case SPECIES_SHAYMIN: // land, sky
2248 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2249 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing / 2 + 0x86 + form * 2);
2250 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xE8 + form * 2);
2251 break;
2252 case SPECIES_ROTOM: // normal, fan, mow, wash, heat, frost
2253 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2254 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing / 2 + 0x8A + form * 2);
2255 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xEC + form * 2);
2256 break;
2257 case SPECIES_GIRATINA: // altered, origin
2258 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2259 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing / 2 + 0x96 + form * 2);
2260 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xF8 + form * 2);
2261 break;
2262 case SPECIES_PICHU: // spiky-ear
2263 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_otherpoke;
2264 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(whichFacing / 2 + 0x9A + form * 2);
2265 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + 0xFC + form * 2);
2266 break;
2267 default:
2268 pokepicTemplate->narcID = NARC_poketool_pokegra_pokegra;
2269 pokepicTemplate->charDataID = (u16)(species * 6 + whichFacing + (gender == MON_FEMALE ? 0 : 1));
2270 pokepicTemplate->palDataID = (u16)(shiny + (species * 6 + 4));
2271 if (species == SPECIES_SPINDA && whichFacing == MON_PIC_FACING_FRONT) {
2272 pokepicTemplate->species = SPECIES_SPINDA;
2273 pokepicTemplate->isAnimated = FALSE;
2274 pokepicTemplate->personality = personality;

2762BOOL Pokemon_TryLevelUp(Pokemon *mon) {
2763 u16 species = (u16)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL);
2764 u8 level = (u8)(GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_LEVEL, NULL) + 1);
2765 u32 exp = GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_EXPERIENCE, NULL);
2766 u32 growthrate = (u32)GetMonBaseStat(species, BASE_GROWTH_RATE);
2767 u32 maxexp = GetExpByGrowthRateAndLevel((int)growthrate, 100);
2768 if (exp > maxexp) {
2769 exp = maxexp;
2770 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_EXPERIENCE, &exp);
2771 }
2772 if (level > 100) {
2773 return FALSE;
2774 }
2775 if (exp >= GetExpByGrowthRateAndLevel((int)growthrate, level)) {
2776 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_LEVEL, &level);
2777 return TRUE;
2778 }
2779 return FALSE;
2780}

2782u16 GetMonEvolution(Party *party, Pokemon *mon, u8 context, u16 usedItem, int *method_ret) {
2783 u16 species;
2784 u16 heldItem;
2785 u8 level;
2786 int i;
2787 u16 target = SPECIES_NONE;
2788 u16 friendship;
2789 u32 pid;
2790 u8 holdEffect;
2791 u8 beauty; // for Feebas, but queried unconditionally.
2792 u16 pid_hi = 0;
2793 struct Evolution *evoTable;
2794 int method_local;
2795
2796 species = GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL);
2797 heldItem = GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_HELD_ITEM, NULL);
2798 pid = GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_PERSONALITY, NULL);
2799 beauty = GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_BEAUTY, NULL);
2800 pid_hi = (u16)((pid & 0xFFFF0000) >> 16);
2801 holdEffect = GetItemAttr(heldItem, ITEMATTR_HOLD_EFFECT, HEAP_ID_DEFAULT);
2802 // Kadabra bypasses Everstone because he's just that broken.
2803 if (species != SPECIES_KADABRA && holdEffect == HOLD_EFFECT_NO_EVOLVE && context != EVOCTX_ITEM_USE) {
2804 return SPECIES_NONE;
2805 }
2806 // Spiky-ear Pichu cannot evolve
2807 if (species == SPECIES_PICHU && GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_FORM, 0) == 1) {
2808 return SPECIES_NONE;
2809 }
2810 if (method_ret == NULL) {
2811 method_ret = &method_local;
2812 }
2813 evoTable = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_DEFAULT, MAX_EVOS_PER_POKE * sizeof(struct Evolution));
2814 LoadMonEvolutionTable(species, evoTable);
2815 switch (context) {
2816 case EVOCTX_LEVELUP:
2817 level = (u8)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_LEVEL, NULL);
2818 friendship = (u16)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_FRIENDSHIP, NULL);
2819 for (i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
2820 switch (evoTable[i].method) {
2821 case EVO_NONE:
2822 break;
2823 case EVO_FRIENDSHIP:
2824 if (friendship >= 220) {
2825 target = evoTable[i].target;
2826 *method_ret = EVO_FRIENDSHIP;
2827 }
2828 break;
2829 case EVO_FRIENDSHIP_DAY:
2830 if (IsNighttime() == 0 && friendship >= 220) {
2831 target = evoTable[i].target;
2832 *method_ret = EVO_FRIENDSHIP_DAY;
2833 }
2834 break;
2835 case EVO_FRIENDSHIP_NIGHT:
2836 if (IsNighttime() == 1 && friendship >= 220) {
2837 target = evoTable[i].target;
2838 *method_ret = EVO_FRIENDSHIP_NIGHT;
2839 }
2840 break;
2841 case EVO_LEVEL:
2842 if (evoTable[i].param <= level) {
2843 target = evoTable[i].target;
2844 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL;
2845 }
2846 break;
2847 case EVO_TRADE:
2848 break;
2849 case EVO_TRADE_ITEM:
2850 break;
2851 case EVO_STONE:
2852 break;
2853 case EVO_LEVEL_ATK_GT_DEF:
2854 if (evoTable[i].param <= level && GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_ATK, NULL) > GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_DEF, NULL)) {
2855 target = evoTable[i].target;
2856 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL_ATK_GT_DEF;
2857 }
2858 break;
2859 case EVO_LEVEL_ATK_EQ_DEF:
2860 if (evoTable[i].param <= level && GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_ATK, NULL) == GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_DEF, NULL)) {
2861 target = evoTable[i].target;
2862 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL_ATK_EQ_DEF;
2863 }
2864 break;
2865 case EVO_LEVEL_ATK_LT_DEF:
2866 if (evoTable[i].param <= level && GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_ATK, NULL) < GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_DEF, NULL)) {
2867 target = evoTable[i].target;
2868 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL_ATK_LT_DEF;
2869 }
2870 break;
2871 case EVO_LEVEL_PID_LO:
2872 if (evoTable[i].param <= level && pid_hi % 10 < 5) {
2873 target = evoTable[i].target;
2874 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL_PID_LO;
2875 }
2876 break;
2877 case EVO_LEVEL_PID_HI:
2878 if (evoTable[i].param <= level && pid_hi % 10 >= 5) {
2879 target = evoTable[i].target;
2880 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL_PID_HI;
2881 }
2882 break;
2883 case EVO_LEVEL_NINJASK:
2884 if (evoTable[i].param <= level) {
2885 target = evoTable[i].target;
2886 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL_NINJASK;
2887 }
2888 break;
2889 case EVO_LEVEL_SHEDINJA:
2890 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL_SHEDINJA;
2891 break;
2892 case EVO_BEAUTY:
2893 if (evoTable[i].param <= beauty) {
2894 target = evoTable[i].target;
2895 *method_ret = EVO_BEAUTY;
2896 }
2897 break;
2898 case EVO_STONE_MALE:
2899 break;
2900 case EVO_STONE_FEMALE:
2901 break;
2902 case EVO_ITEM_DAY:
2903 if (IsNighttime() == 0 && evoTable[i].param == heldItem) {
2904 target = evoTable[i].target;
2905 *method_ret = EVO_ITEM_DAY;
2906 }
2907 break;
2908 case EVO_ITEM_NIGHT:
2909 if (IsNighttime() == 1 && evoTable[i].param == heldItem) {
2910 target = evoTable[i].target;
2911 *method_ret = EVO_ITEM_NIGHT;
2912 }
2913 break;
2914 case EVO_HAS_MOVE:
2915 if (MonHasMove(mon, evoTable[i].param) == TRUE) {
2916 target = evoTable[i].target;
2917 *method_ret = EVO_HAS_MOVE;
2918 }
2919 break;
2920 case EVO_OTHER_PARTY_MON:
2921 if (party != NULL && Party_HasMon(party, evoTable[i].param) == 1) {
2922 target = evoTable[i].target;
2923 *method_ret = EVO_OTHER_PARTY_MON;
2924 }
2925 break;
2926 case EVO_LEVEL_MALE:
2927 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_GENDER, NULL) == MON_MALE && evoTable[i].param <= level) {
2928 target = evoTable[i].target;
2929 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL_MALE;
2930 }
2931 break;
2932 case EVO_LEVEL_FEMALE:
2933 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_GENDER, NULL) == MON_FEMALE && evoTable[i].param <= level) {
2934 target = evoTable[i].target;
2935 *method_ret = EVO_LEVEL_FEMALE;
2936 }
2937 break;
2938 case EVO_CORONET:
2939 if (usedItem == evoTable[i].method) {
2940 target = evoTable[i].target;
2941 *method_ret = EVO_CORONET;
2942 }
2943 break;
2944 case EVO_ETERNA:
2945 if (usedItem == evoTable[i].method) {
2946 target = evoTable[i].target;
2947 *method_ret = EVO_ETERNA;
2948 }
2949 break;
2950 case EVO_ROUTE217:
2951 if (usedItem == evoTable[i].method) {
2952 target = evoTable[i].target;
2953 *method_ret = EVO_ROUTE217;
2954 }
2955 break;
2956 }
2957 if (target != SPECIES_NONE) {
2958 break;
2959 }
2960 }
2961 break;
2962 case EVOCTX_TRADE:
2963 for (i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
2964 switch (evoTable[i].method) {
2965 case EVO_TRADE:
2966 target = evoTable[i].target;
2967 *method_ret = EVO_TRADE;
2968 break;
2969 case EVO_TRADE_ITEM:
2970 if (heldItem == evoTable[i].param) {
2971 target = evoTable[i].target;
2972 *method_ret = EVO_TRADE_ITEM;
2973 }
2974 break;
2975 }
2976 if (target != SPECIES_NONE) {
2977 break;
2978 }
2979 }
2980 break;
2981 case EVOCTX_ITEM_CHECK:
2982 case EVOCTX_ITEM_USE:
2983 for (i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
2984 if (evoTable[i].method == EVO_STONE && usedItem == evoTable[i].param) {
2985 target = evoTable[i].target;
2986 *method_ret = 0;
2987 break;
2988 }
2989 if (evoTable[i].method == EVO_STONE_MALE && GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_GENDER, NULL) == MON_MALE && usedItem == evoTable[i].param) {
2990 target = evoTable[i].target;
2991 *method_ret = 0;
2992 break;
2993 }
2994 if (evoTable[i].method == EVO_STONE_FEMALE && GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_GENDER, NULL) == MON_FEMALE && usedItem == evoTable[i].param) {
2995 target = evoTable[i].target;
2996 *method_ret = 0;
2997 break;
2998 }
2999 }
3000 break;
3001 }
3002 Heap_Free(evoTable);
3003 return target;
3004}

3035void InitBoxMonMoveset(BoxPokemon *boxMon) {
3036 BOOL decry;

3041 u8 level;
3042 u16 move;
3043 levelUpLearnset = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_DEFAULT, MAX_LEARNED_MOVES * sizeof(u16));
3044 decry = AcquireBoxMonLock(boxMon);
3045 species = (u16)GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL);
3046 form = GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_FORM, NULL);
3047 level = (u8)CalcBoxMonLevel(boxMon);
3048 LoadLevelUpLearnset_HandleAlternateForm(species, (int)form, levelUpLearnset);
3049 for (i = 0; levelUpLearnset[i] != LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_END; i++) {
3050 if ((levelUpLearnset[i] & LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_LEVEL_MASK) > (level << LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_LEVEL_SHIFT)) {
3051 break;

3053 move = LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_MOVE(levelUpLearnset[i]);
3054 if (TryAppendBoxMonMove(boxMon, move) == MOVE_APPEND_FULL) {

3056 }
3057 }
3058 Heap_Free(levelUpLearnset);
3059 ReleaseBoxMonLock(boxMon, decry);
3060}

3066u32 TryAppendBoxMonMove(BoxPokemon *boxMon, u16 move) {

3073 if (cur_move == MOVE_NONE) {
3074 BoxMonSetMoveInSlot(boxMon, move, (u8)i);
3075 ret = move;
3076 break;
3077 }
3078 if (cur_move == move) {
3079 ret = MOVE_APPEND_KNOWN;
3080 break;
3081 }
3082 }
3083 ReleaseBoxMonLock(boxMon, decry);
3084 return ret;
3085}

3142u32 MonTryLearnMoveOnLevelUp(Pokemon *mon, int *last_i, u16 *sp0) {
3143 u32 ret = 0;
3144 u16 *levelUpLearnset = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_DEFAULT, MAX_LEARNED_MOVES * sizeof(u16));
3145 u16 species = (u16)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL);
3146 u32 form = GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_FORM, NULL);
3147 u8 level = (u8)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_LEVEL, NULL);
3148 LoadLevelUpLearnset_HandleAlternateForm(species, (int)form, levelUpLearnset);
3149
3150 if (levelUpLearnset[*last_i] == LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_END) {
3151 Heap_Free(levelUpLearnset);
3152 return 0;
3153 }
3154 while ((levelUpLearnset[*last_i] & LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_LEVEL_MASK) != (level << LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_LEVEL_SHIFT)) {
3155 (*last_i)++;
3156 if (levelUpLearnset[*last_i] == LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_END) {
3157 Heap_Free(levelUpLearnset);
3158 return 0;
3159 }
3160 }
3161 if ((levelUpLearnset[*last_i] & LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_LEVEL_MASK) == (level << LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_LEVEL_SHIFT)) {
3162 *sp0 = LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_MOVE(levelUpLearnset[*last_i]);
3163 (*last_i)++;
3164 ret = TryAppendMonMove(mon, *sp0);
3165 }
3166 Heap_Free(levelUpLearnset);
3167 return ret;
3168}

3312void Party_GivePokerusAtRandom(Party *party) {
3313 int count = Party_GetCount(party);
3314 int idx;
3315 Pokemon *mon;
3316 u8 sp0;
3317 switch (LCRandom()) {
3318 case 0x4000:
3319 case 0x8000:
3320 case 0xC000:
3321 do {
3322 idx = LCRandom() % count;
3323 mon = Party_GetMonByIndex(party, idx);
3324 } while (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL) == SPECIES_NONE || GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_IS_EGG, NULL));
3325 if (!Party_MaskMonsWithPokerus(party, (u8)MaskOfFlagNo(idx))) {
3326 do {
3327 sp0 = (u8)LCRandom();
3328 } while (!(sp0 & 7));
3329 if (sp0 & 0xF0) {
3330 sp0 &= 7;
3331 }
3332 sp0 |= sp0 << 4;
3333 sp0 &= 0xF3;
3334 sp0++;
3335 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, &sp0);
3336 }
3337 }
3338}
3339
3340u8 Party_MaskMonsWithPokerus(Party *party, u8 mask) {
3341 int i = 0;
3342 u32 flag = 1;
3343 u8 ret = 0;
3344 Pokemon *mon;
3345 if (mask != 0) {
3346 do {
3347 if (mask & 1) {
3348 mon = Party_GetMonByIndex(party, i);
3349 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, NULL)) {
3350 ret |= flag;
3351 }
3352 }
3353 i++;
3354 flag <<= 1;
3355 mask >>= 1;
3356 } while (mask != 0);
3357 } else {
3358 mon = Party_GetMonByIndex(party, 0);
3359 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, NULL)) {
3360 ret++;
3361 }
3362 }
3363 return ret;
3364}

3366void Party_UpdatePokerus(Party *party, int r5) {
3367 int i;
3368 u8 pokerus;
3369 Pokemon *mon;
3370 int count = Party_GetCount(party);
3371 for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
3372 mon = Party_GetMonByIndex(party, i);
3373 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL) != SPECIES_NONE) {
3374 pokerus = (u8)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, NULL);
3375 if (pokerus & 0xF) {
3376 if ((pokerus & 0xF) < r5 || r5 > 4) {
3377 pokerus &= 0xF0;
3378 } else {
3379 pokerus -= r5;
3380 }
3381 if (pokerus == 0) {
3382 pokerus = 0x10; // immune
3383 }
3384 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, &pokerus);
3385 }
3386 }
3387 }
3388}
3389
3390void Party_SpreadPokerus(Party *party) {
3391 int count = Party_GetCount(party);
3392 int i;
3393 Pokemon *mon;
3394 u8 pokerus;
3395 if ((LCRandom() % 3) == 0) {
3396 for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
3397 mon = Party_GetMonByIndex(party, i);
3398 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL) != SPECIES_NONE) {
3399 pokerus = (u8)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, NULL);
3400 if (pokerus & 0xF) {
3401 if (i != 0) {
3402 mon = Party_GetMonByIndex(party, i - 1);
3403 if (!(GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, NULL) & 0xF0)) {
3404 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, &pokerus);
3405 }
3406 }
3407 if (i < count - 1) {
3408 mon = Party_GetMonByIndex(party, i + 1);
3409 if (!(GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, NULL) & 0xF0)) {
3410 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_POKERUS, &pokerus);
3411 i++; // don't infect the rest of the party
3412 }
3413 }
3414 }
3415 }
3416 }
3417 }
3418}

3590BOOL Party_TryResetShaymin(Party *party, int min_max, const RTCTime *time) {
3591 int hour, minute;
3592 if (time->hour >= 20 || time->hour < 4) {
3593 hour = time->hour;
3594 if (hour < 4) {
3595 hour += 24;
3596 }
3597 minute = time->minute + 60 * (hour - 20);
3598 if (minute < min_max + 1) {
3599 Party_ResetAllShayminToLandForm(party);
3600 return TRUE;
3601 } else {
3602 return FALSE;
3603 }
3604 } else {
3605 hour = time->hour;
3606 minute = time->minute + 60 * (hour - 4);
3607 if (minute < min_max) {
3608 Party_ResetAllShayminToLandForm(party);
3609 return TRUE;
3610 } else {
3611 return FALSE;
3612 }
3613 }
3614}

3616BOOL Mon_UpdateRotomForm(Pokemon *mon, int form, int defaultSlot) {
3617 static const u16 form_moves[ROTOM_FORM_MAX] = {
3618 MOVE_NONE,
3619 MOVE_OVERHEAT,
3620 MOVE_HYDRO_PUMP,
3621 MOVE_BLIZZARD,
3622 MOVE_AIR_SLASH,
3623 MOVE_LEAF_STORM,
3624 };
3625
3626 int i, j;
3627 int cur_move;
3628 int new_move;
3629 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL) != SPECIES_ROTOM) {
3630 return FALSE;
3631 }
3632 GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_FORM, NULL);
3633 new_move = form_moves[form];
3634 for (i = 0; i < MAX_MON_MOVES; i++) {
3635 cur_move = GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_MOVE1 + i, NULL);
3636 for (j = ROTOM_HEAT; j < (unsigned)ROTOM_FORM_MAX; j++) {
3637 if (cur_move != MOVE_NONE && cur_move == form_moves[j]) {
3638 if (new_move != MOVE_NONE) {
3639 MonSetMoveInSlot_ResetPpUp(mon, new_move, i);
3640 new_move = MOVE_NONE;
3641 } else {
3642 MonDeleteMoveSlot(mon, i);
3643 i--;
3644 }
3645 break;
3646 }
3647 }
3648 }
3649 if (new_move != MOVE_NONE) {
3650 for (i = 0; i < MAX_MON_MOVES; i++) {
3651 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_MOVE1 + i, NULL) == MOVE_NONE) {
3652 MonSetMoveInSlot_ResetPpUp(mon, new_move, i);
3653 break;
3654 }
3655 }
3656 if (i == MAX_MON_MOVES) {
3657 MonSetMoveInSlot_ResetPpUp(mon, new_move, defaultSlot);
3658 }
3659 }
3660 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_MOVE1, NULL) == MOVE_NONE) {
3661 MonSetMoveInSlot_ResetPpUp(mon, MOVE_THUNDER_SHOCK, 0);
3662 }
3663 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_FORM, &form);
3664 UpdateMonAbility(mon);
3665 CalcMonLevelAndStats(mon);
3666 return TRUE;
3667}

3741void WildMonSetRandomHeldItem(Pokemon *mon, u32 battleType, u32 isCompoundEyes) {
3742 u32 chance;
3743 u16 species;
3744 u16 form;
3745 u16 item1;
3746 u16 item2;
3747 if (!(battleType & (BATTLE_TYPE_TRAINER | BATTLE_TYPE_FRONTIER))) {
3748 chance = (u32)(LCRandom() % 100);
3749 species = (u16)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, 0);
3750 form = (u16)GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_FORM, 0);
3751 item1 = (u16)GetMonBaseStat_HandleAlternateForm(species, form, BASE_ITEM_1);
3752 item2 = (u16)GetMonBaseStat_HandleAlternateForm(species, form, BASE_ITEM_2);
3753 if (item1 == item2 && item1 != ITEM_NONE) {
3754 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_HELD_ITEM, &item1);
3755 } else {
3756 if (chance >= sItemOdds[isCompoundEyes][0]) {
3757 if (chance < sItemOdds[isCompoundEyes][1]) {
3758 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_HELD_ITEM, &item1);
3759 } else {
3760 SetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_HELD_ITEM, &item2);
3761 }
3762 }
3763 }

3779
3780BOOL GetTMHMCompatBySpeciesAndForm(u16 species, u32 form, u8 tmhm) {
3781 u32 mask;
3782 int baseStat;
3783 if (species == SPECIES_EGG) {
3784 return FALSE;
3785 }
3786
3787 // mask = 1 << (a2 % 32);
3788 // baseStat = BASE_TMHM_1 + (a2 / 32);
3789 if (tmhm < 32) {
3790 mask = 1 << tmhm;
3791 baseStat = BASE_TMHM_1;
3792 } else if (tmhm < 64) {
3793 mask = 1 << (tmhm - 32);
3794 baseStat = BASE_TMHM_2;
3795 } else if (tmhm < 96) {
3796 mask = 1 << (tmhm - 64);
3797 baseStat = BASE_TMHM_3;
3798 } else {
3799 mask = 1 << (tmhm - 96);
3800 baseStat = BASE_TMHM_4;
3801 }
3802 return (GetMonBaseStat_HandleAlternateForm(species, form, baseStat) & mask) != 0;
3803}

3809void UpdateBoxMonAbility(BoxPokemon *boxMon) {

3814 int ability1 = GetMonBaseStat_HandleAlternateForm(species, form, BASE_ABILITY_1);
3815 int ability2 = GetMonBaseStat_HandleAlternateForm(species, form, BASE_ABILITY_2);
3816 if (ability2 != ABILITY_NONE) {
3817 if (pid & 1) {
3818 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_ABILITY, &ability2);
3819 } else {
3820 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_ABILITY, &ability1);
3821 }
3822 } else {
3823 SetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_ABILITY, &ability1);
3824 }
3825 ReleaseBoxMonLock(boxMon, decry);
3826}

3828void SetMonPersonality(Pokemon *mon, u32 personality) {
3829 PokemonDataBlockA *r4;
3830 PokemonDataBlockB *r6;
3831 PokemonDataBlockC *r7;
3832 PokemonDataBlockD *sp8;
3833 PokemonDataBlockA *spC;
3834 PokemonDataBlockB *sp10;
3835 PokemonDataBlockC *sp14;
3836 PokemonDataBlockD *sp18;
3837 Pokemon *tmpMon;
3838
3839 tmpMon = AllocMonZeroed(HEAP_ID_DEFAULT);
3840 CopyPokemonToPokemon(mon, tmpMon);
3841 r4 = &GetSubstruct(&tmpMon->box, mon->box.personality, 0)->blockA;
3842 r6 = &GetSubstruct(&tmpMon->box, mon->box.personality, 1)->blockB;
3843 r7 = &GetSubstruct(&tmpMon->box, mon->box.personality, 2)->blockC;
3844 sp8 = &GetSubstruct(&tmpMon->box, mon->box.personality, 3)->blockD;
3845 spC = &GetSubstruct(&mon->box, personality, 0)->blockA;
3846 sp10 = &GetSubstruct(&mon->box, personality, 1)->blockB;
3847 sp14 = &GetSubstruct(&mon->box, personality, 2)->blockC;
3848 sp18 = &GetSubstruct(&mon->box, personality, 3)->blockD;
3849
3850 DECRYPT_BOX(&tmpMon->box);
3851 DECRYPT_PTY(mon);
3852 DECRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
3853 mon->box.personality = personality;
3854 *spC = *r4;
3855 *sp10 = *r6;
3856 *sp14 = *r7;
3857 *sp18 = *sp8;
3858 mon->box.checksum = CHECKSUM(&mon->box);
3859 ENCRYPT_BOX(&mon->box);
3860 ENCRYPT_PTY(mon);
3861 Heap_Free(tmpMon);
3862}
3863
3864u32 ChangePersonalityToNatureGenderAndAbility(u32 pid, u16 species, u8 nature, u8 gender, u8 ability, BOOL gen_mode) {
3865 // u32 pid is a random seed to convolve into a pid that bears the
3866 // requested nature, gender, and ability. This is used to make
3867 // pokemon caught on the Pokewalker, and the Spiky-Eared Pichu.
3868 // In both actual use cases, u32 pid is OTID, which means r4 and r1
3869 // are always SID ^ TID.
3870 GF_ASSERT(ability < 2);
3871 GF_ASSERT(gender != 0xFF);
3872 if (gen_mode) {
3873 u32 r4 = ((pid & 0xFFFF0000) >> 16) ^ (u16)pid;
3874 pid = GenPersonalityByGenderAndNature(species, gender, nature);
3875 if ((pid & 1) != ability) {
3876 // Force correct ability for gender and nature pid
3877 pid++;
3878 }
3879 pid |= ((u16)pid ^ r4) << 16;
3880 } else {
3881 u32 r1;
3882 u8 ratio = GetMonBaseStat(species, BASE_GENDER_RATIO);
3883 GF_ASSERT((nature & 1) == ability);
3884 r1 = ((pid & 0xFFFF0000) >> 16) ^ (u16)pid;
3885 pid = (0xFF00 ^ (r1 & 0xFF00)) << 16;
3886 // Force the pid to have the requested nature
3887 pid += nature - (pid % 25);
3888 // Maintaining that pid%25 is nature, and pid&1 is ability,
3889 // ensure pid&0xFF compared to the gender ratio yields gender
3890 switch (ratio) {
3891 case MON_RATIO_MALE:
3892 case MON_RATIO_FEMALE:
3893 case MON_RATIO_UNKNOWN:
3894 break;
3895 default:
3896 if (gender == MON_MALE) {
3897 if (ratio > (u8)pid) {
3898 // pid is female; force pid to become male
3899 pid += 25 * ((ratio - (u8)pid) / 25u + 1);
3900 if ((pid & 1) != ability) {
3901 GF_ASSERT((u8)pid <= 230);
3902 pid += 25;
3903 }
3904 }
3905 } else {
3906 if (ratio < (u8)pid) {
3907 // pid is male; force pid to become female
3908 pid -= 25 * (((u8)pid - ratio) / 25u + 1);
3909 if ((pid & 1) != ability) {
3910 GF_ASSERT((u8)pid >= 25);
3911 pid -= 25;
3912 }
3913 }
3914 }
3915 break;
3916 }
3917 }
3918 return pid;
3919}

3992int ResolveMonForm(int species, int form) {
3993 switch (species) {
3994 case SPECIES_DEOXYS:
3995 if (form != DEOXYS_NORMAL && form <= DEOXYS_FORM_MAX - 1) {
3996 return SPECIES_DEOXYS_ATK + form - DEOXYS_ATTACK;
3997 }
3998 break;
3999 case SPECIES_WORMADAM:
4000 if (form != WORMADAM_PLANT && form <= WORMADAM_FORM_MAX - 1) {
4001 return SPECIES_WORMADAM_SANDY + form - WORMADAM_SANDY;
4002 }
4003 break;
4004 case SPECIES_GIRATINA:
4005 if (form != GIRATINA_ALTERED && form <= GIRATINA_FORM_MAX - 1) {
4006 return SPECIES_GIRATINA_ORIGIN + form - GIRATINA_ORIGIN;
4007 }
4008 break;
4009 case SPECIES_SHAYMIN:
4010 if (form != SHAYMIN_LAND && form <= SHAYMIN_FORM_MAX - 1) {
4011 return SPECIES_SHAYMIN_SKY + form - SHAYMIN_SKY;
4012 }
4013 break;
4014 case SPECIES_ROTOM:
4015 if (form != ROTOM_NORMAL && form <= ROTOM_FORM_MAX - 1) {
4016 return SPECIES_ROTOM_HEAT + form - ROTOM_HEAT;
4017 }
4018 break;
4019 }
4020 return species;
4021}

4027 GF_ASSERT(flagno < 32);
4028 for (i = 0; i < flagno; i++) {
4029 ret <<= 1;

4034int LowestFlagNo(u32 mask) {
4035 // ctz
4036 int i;
4037 u32 bit = 1;
4038 for (i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
4039 if (mask & bit) {
4040 break;
4041 }
4042 bit <<= 1;
4043 }
4044 return i;
4045}

4132int TrainerClassToBackpicID(int trainerClass, BOOL isLink) {
4133 switch (trainerClass) {
4134 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_ETHAN:
4135 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_LYRA:
4136 if (isLink) {
4137 return trainerClass - TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_ETHAN + TRAINER_BACKPIC_ETHAN_2;
4138 } else {
4139 return trainerClass - TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_ETHAN + TRAINER_BACKPIC_ETHAN;
4140 }
4141 case TRAINERCLASS_RIVAL:
4142 return TRAINER_BACKPIC_RIVAL;
4143 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_LUCAS_DP:
4144 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_DAWN_DP:
4145 return trainerClass - TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_LUCAS_DP + TRAINER_BACKPIC_LUCAS_DP;
4146 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_LANCE:
4147 return TRAINER_BACKPIC_LANCE;
4148 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_CHERYL:
4149 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_RILEY:
4150 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_BUCK:
4151 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_MIRA:
4152 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_MARLEY:
4153 return trainerClass - TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_CHERYL + TRAINER_BACKPIC_CHERYL;
4154 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_LUCAS_PT:
4155 case TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_DAWN_PT:
4156 return trainerClass - TRAINERCLASS_PKMN_TRAINER_LUCAS_PT + TRAINER_BACKPIC_LUCAS_PT;
4157 default:
4158 if (TrainerClass_GetGenderOrTrainerCount(trainerClass) == TRAINER_FEMALE) {
4159 return TRAINER_BACKPIC_LYRA;
4160 } else {
4161 return TRAINER_BACKPIC_ETHAN;
4162 }
4163 }
4164 return trainerClass;
4165}

4969void CalcBoxMonPokeathlonPerformance(BoxPokemon *boxMon, struct PokeathlonTodayPerformance *dest) {
4970 u32 pid;
4971 u32 nature;
4972 struct PokeathlonBasePerformance data;
4973 RTCDate date;
4974 RTCTime time;
4975 int i;
4976 s16 day;
4977 u16 species;
4978 u16 form;
4979
4980 pid = GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_PERSONALITY, NULL);
4981 nature = GetBoxMonNature(boxMon);
4982 GF_RTC_CopyDateTime(&date, &time);
4983 day = date.day;
4984
4985 for (i = PERFORMANCE_MIN; i < PERFORMANCE_MAX; i++) {
4986 u32 pid_digit = _u32_getDigitN(pid, i);
4987 dest->stats[i].dailyMod = sPokeathlonPerformanceNatureMods[nature][i] + (2 * _u32_getDigitN(pid_digit + (day + (7 - i)) * (day + (i + 3)), 0) - 9);
4988 }
4989
4990 species = GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL);
4991 form = GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_FORM, NULL);
4992 ReadWholeNarcMemberByIdPair(&data, NARC_poketool_personal_performance, sPokeathlonPerformanceArcIdxs[species] + form);
4993 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_POWER].base = data.base[ARCPERF_POWER];
4994 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_POWER].lo = data.minmax[ARCPERF_POWER][0];
4995 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_POWER].hi = data.minmax[ARCPERF_POWER][1];
4996 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_SKILL].base = data.base[ARCPERF_SKILL];
4997 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_SKILL].lo = data.minmax[ARCPERF_SKILL][0];
4998 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_SKILL].hi = data.minmax[ARCPERF_SKILL][1];
4999 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_SPEED].base = data.base[ARCPERF_SPEED];
5000 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_SPEED].lo = data.minmax[ARCPERF_SPEED][0];
5001 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_SPEED].hi = data.minmax[ARCPERF_SPEED][1];
5002 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_JUMP].base = data.base[ARCPERF_JUMP];
5003 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_JUMP].lo = data.minmax[ARCPERF_JUMP][0];
5004 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_JUMP].hi = data.minmax[ARCPERF_JUMP][1];
5005 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_STAMINA].base = data.base[ARCPERF_STAMINA];
5006 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_STAMINA].lo = data.minmax[ARCPERF_STAMINA][0];
5007 dest->stats[PERFORMANCE_STAMINA].hi = data.minmax[ARCPERF_STAMINA][1];
5008}
5009
5010void CalcMonPokeathlonPerformance(Pokemon *mon, struct PokeathlonTodayPerformance *dest) {
5011 CalcBoxMonPokeathlonPerformance(Mon_GetBoxMon(mon), dest);
5012}
5013
5014void CalcBoxmonPokeathlonStars(struct PokeathlonPerformanceStars *dest, BoxPokemon *boxMon, const s8 *aprijuice, enum HeapID heapID) {
5015#pragma unused(heapID)
5016 int i;
5017 struct PokeathlonTodayPerformance basePerf;
5018
5019 MI_CpuClear8(dest, sizeof(struct PokeathlonPerformanceStars));
5020 CalcBoxMonPokeathlonPerformance(boxMon, &basePerf);
5021 for (i = PERFORMANCE_MIN; i < PERFORMANCE_MAX; i++) {
5022 s16 stars = (aprijuice != NULL
5023 ? PokeathlonStatScoreToStars(basePerf.stats[i].dailyMod + aprijuice[i])
5024 : PokeathlonStatScoreToStars(basePerf.stats[i].dailyMod));
5025 stars += basePerf.stats[i].base;
5026 if (stars < basePerf.stats[i].lo) {
5027 stars = basePerf.stats[i].lo;
5028 } else if (stars > basePerf.stats[i].hi) {
5029 stars = basePerf.stats[i].hi;
5030 }
5031 if (stars == basePerf.stats[i].base) {
5032 dest->color[i] = STARS_AT_BASE;
5033 } else if (stars < basePerf.stats[i].base) {
5034 dest->color[i] = STARS_BELOW_BASE;
5035 } else {
5036 dest->color[i] = STARS_ABOVE_BASE;
5037 }
5038 dest->stars |= stars << (3 * i);
5039 }
5040}
5041
5042void CalcMonPokeathlonStars(struct PokeathlonPerformanceStars *dest, Pokemon *mon, const s8 *aprijuice, enum HeapID heapID) {
5043 CalcBoxmonPokeathlonStars(dest, Mon_GetBoxMon(mon), aprijuice, heapID);
5044}
